tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /las gshin gyi bsnyen pa bya tshul bzhugs so// 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje'i bsnyen pa bya tshul ni/ 'jam mgon sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa bzhin la/ dpa' gcig byed na gtor ma gru gsum sha mar gyi rgyan ldan gcig bcu gsum ma byed na gru gsum che chung gnyis la phyogs bzhi'i phyi nang dang / mtshams bzhir gru gsum chung ba re re thams cad la sha mar rgyan ldan/ 'byor na gtor gdugs nag po gcig dang bcas pa mdun du drag mchod sbrengs tshar bcas bshams/ zla ba gang rung gi nyer dgu lta bu la dgong thun nas dbu btsugs te 'jigs byed kyi bdag bskyed byas la/ yi dam chos skyong rnams kyi gtor bsngo'i rim pa bzlas pa dang bcas byed tshul nged rang nas brtsams pa'i 'jigs byed drug cu'i gtong deb bzhin byas la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par las gshin dpa' gcig la bsnyen pa byed na bskyed chog mchod gtor bstod bskul rnams sgrub thabs bzhin dang / 'di bdud 'joms snang ba'i gter mdzod yin pas/ des na las gshin dpa' gcig la yum med/ rje sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyi bsnyen yig nas yum gsungs pa ni/ ngag dbang chos grags kyi las gshin/ rigs gsum gyi sgrub thabs sogs dang cha 'dra mdzad rgyu yin pa 'dra'o/ /bzlas pa sngags ring thung yongs rdzogs las yum sngags mi bzla/ bcu gsum ma ltar na 'phrin las tsha zer nas 'byung ba ltar ram/ yang na mchod pa yongs rdzogs sngags tsam la bsdus pas chog gang ltar na'ang thun thams cad la hrīḥṣ+ṭiḥphreng 'khor res gnya' mnan la las gshin gyi rtsa sngags snying po nye snying gang la bsnyen pa byed na'ang 'dam kha yin pas/ rtsa sngags la byed na yi ge bcu bzhi 'khri ba dang / ma 'khri ba gang rung 'bum bco lnga bzla/ snying po nye snying gnyis dang yum la 'bru 'bum bzla'o/ /thor snga srod gsum gyi thun la 'jigs byed bdag bskyed dang / de'i gtor bsngo phyogs skyong las gshin rnams byas la bzlas pa bya/

dgong thun la rang re'i gtor bsngo chen mo dang sbrel nas byed na gong bzhin dang / mi byed na thor thun sogs bzhin no/ /gang ltar bzlas pa rdzogs nas/ 'jigs byed la mchod bstod dang / las gshin la dpa' gcig ltar na/ hūm̐ 'chi bdag nag po lho phyogs kyi/ /zhes sogs dang / bcu gsum ma ltar na/ 'di nas lho yi phyogs rol na/ /zhes sogs kyi bskul dang 'phrin bcol byas la rjes chog la 'jug las gshin bcu gsum ma'i spyan 'dren skabs rgyun dang las sbyor dus kyi tshig mi 'dra ba'i khyad par/ 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i/ las gshin bcu gsum ma'i/ mchod chog na gsal/ gzhan tshang ma 'jam mgon sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyi gsung bzhin no// //dge'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ las gshin gyi bsnyen pa bya tshul/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
